1.title: Hegseth Summons Troops for a ‘State of the Force’ Address
1.summary: The gathering comes as the defense secretary is facing precarious times as the public face of the Trump administration’s unpopular war against Iran.

2.title: What we know about Cornell University frat house rape investigation
2.summary: The woman alleges she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house at the university two years ago.

3.title: California Couple Charged With Murder in Shooting of Son-in-Law
3.summary: Shouyong Zhang and Shili Chen were accused of planning the killing of Jonathan McKinsey, an engineer who worked in the games department of The New York Times, near a park in Dublin, Calif.

4.title: Live Updates: Plane to Israel Narrowly Averts Disaster After Pilot Stabbing
4.summary: Passengers said that they broke into the cockpit and subdued the attacker, who Israeli officials said was one of the pilots. The motive for the attack was not clear.

5.title: In Fractious France, Politicians Agree on One Thing: Pope Leo Was a Hit
5.summary: In a four-day visit, Pope Leo XIV won praise across the political spectrum, even from its most avowedly secular figures.

6.title: UK Believes Iran Played a Part in RAF Fairford Air Base Incident, Burnham Says
6.summary: The British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said there were “strong indications” Iran played a part in the events at R.A.F. Fairford on Sunday, without providing details why.
